events.verdict: Goodwin (SAS) makes illegal contact to Fox's (SAS) arm at the start of his drive.
Vassell (SAS) directly contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Booker's (PHX) hand after the release.
Fleming (PHX) makes illegal foot contact with Wembanyama (SAS) as he returns to the floor during his jump shot attempt.
Replay review of the foul called on Vassell (SAS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Vassell jumps into Booker (PHX) while pursuing the rebound, dislodging him from his position
Vassell (SAS) and Booker (PHX) briefly engage and disengage as they move off of the ball.
Wembanyama (SAS) steps on Ighodaro's (PHX) foot and falls to the floor as a result of the incidental contact.
Gillespie (PHX) legally contests Vassell's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Booker (PHX) makes illegal contact to Wembanyama's (SAS) head as he secures the rebound.
Booker (PHX) gathers the ball and takes three steps into his shooting motion.
Vassell (SAS) legally contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Booker's (PHX) shot attempt goes out of bounds and SAS is given possession.
Ighodaro (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Fox's (SAS) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Green (PHX) gathers the pass and takes more than two steps before coming to a stop.
Wembanyama (SAS) commits a take foul on Fleming (PHX).
Ighodaro (PHX) legally contests Wembanyama's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Fox (SAS) is legally moving along Booker's (PHX) path when Booker clips the back of his foot.
